headline: Tata Steel Postpones 40 MTPA Domestic Capacity Target
summary: Tata Steel announced that its target to reach 40 million tonnes per annum of domestic steelmaking capacity will be delayed by three to five years, as it seeks state support for green steel in Europe.
why: Tata Steel is one of India's two largest primary steel producers. Capital expenditure delays influence domestic infrastructure supply and industrial growth projections.

impacts.name: Tata Steel
impacts.why: Pushing back long-term domestic capacity expansion targets lowers medium-term volume projections.
